hacker-granted-class-upgrade-replacement.head: 1631a3a4b57eb65c756ff289e54af09f8de7f56e
hacker-granted-class-upgrade-replacement.scope: Stock Actions showed all four granted children. Owner bonus records show distinct +7 Concentration sources on all four and Viral Accuracy +6/+9/+6/+6. Viral Damage +4/+10/+2 disappears under 1079. 1086 adds +10 Virus Area Radius and 1079 adds +10 Inner Strength Regen Rate. Stock replacement removes the previous records before applying the new source. Parent Hardline load/unload was outside this run.

stats.source: GOB 390 provides raw +2 to ballistic (1027) and melee (1143) defense and grants 1079 at rank zero. The source-qualified tuple is pinned in research/protocol/loaded-grant-membership.json.
stats.runtime: The loaded passive supplies +1 per typed combat defense at level 50 through AbilityStats.Defense. The ordinary live load path adds the granted action, removes it with the parent, and restores it once on reload.

targeting.source: GOB 1083 is a caster-only class upgrade with +4 viral damage, +6 viral accuracy and +7 concentration.
targeting.runtime: The normal granted action with a hostile NPC selected applies its exact modifier snapshot to the caster. A following class upgrade removes the prior sourced snapshot, and the granted action starts its 30-second reuse.
targeting.test: The ability-parity-hacker-disciplines disposable probe activates the grant through the ordinary request. AbilityScaledBuffTests.HackerClassUpgradesChangeTheActualConsumersAndRemoveTheirEffects covers the gameplay inputs and cleanup.
